service.method: SELECT SMR_NUMBER , SEQ , RECENT , ERP_CODE , APP_STATUS , POSTPROCESSED , APPLY_FOR , CONFIRM_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME FROM DLCON_IF_APP WHERE POSTPROCESSED = 'N' AND RECENT = 'Y' ORDER BY ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME
SELECT SMR_NUMBER FROM DLCON_IF_APP WHERE SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND RECENT = 'Y' AND APP_STATUS = 'C'
SELECT ERP_CODE FROM DLCON_IF_APP WHERE SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SEQ = 1
SELECT MANAGE_NUMBER , SUBJECT , SEAL_STATUS , SEAL_TYPE , SEAL_MG_DEPT , SEAL_MG_USER_ID FROM SSEAL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '002' AND COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND MANAGE_NUMBER IN ($IN{MANAGE_NUMBERS})
SELECT HOUSE_CODE , USER_COMPANY_CODE , EXTRA_PARAM , PRIVATE_CODE FROM ULNUS WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (PRIVATE_CODE = ${LINK_CODE} OR CODE = ${LINK_CODE}) AND USER_ID = 'TEMP_USER' AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'
